sentences.japanese: ライオンが獣の王であるのと同様、鷲は鳥の王である。
sentences.english: As the lion is king of beasts, so is the eagle king of birds.

sentences.japanese: 人間は、考え、話すことができるという点で、獣と違う。
sentences.english: Men differ from brutes in that they can think and speak.

sentences.japanese: 原始人はどう猛な獣を見ておびえた。
sentences.english: The primitive man was frightened at the sight of a savage beast.

sentences.japanese: 人にとって人以上に恐怖となる獣は世界に存在しない。
sentences.english: For man, there is no beast more scary than man.
